preset.commands.help: Imported ST completion presets as a room style layer: .preset [list] | import <server file> | enable <id> | disable | show <id>. One preset per room; sampling params are reported, not applied.
preset.commands.usage: Usage: .preset [list] | import <server file> | enable <id> | disable | show <id>
preset.commands.denied: Only an authenticated Keeper can import or switch presets (they reshape the room's prompt).
preset.commands.no_file: Could not read a preset file at {path}.
preset.commands.imported: Imported preset “{id}”: {prompts} prompt(s), {effective} effective, {warnings} warning(s). Enable with `.preset enable {id}`.
preset.commands.enabled: Preset “{id}” is now this room's style layer.
preset.commands.disabled: Preset style layer disabled for this room.
preset.commands.list_empty: No presets installed. A keeper imports one with `.preset import <server file>`.
preset.commands.show: Preset “{id}” ({name}): {prompts} prompt(s), {effective} effective; sampling: {sampling}; macros: {macros}; warnings: {warnings}.
